games.title: Ports of Call
games.dev: Aegis Interactive / Rolf-Dieter Klein & Martin Ulrich
games.note: German shipping-tycoon and harbour-docking simulator that became a staple multiplayer floppy-swap classic across European Amiga households.

games.title: Silkworm
games.note: Asymmetric two-player shoot-'em-up where one player flies a helicopter and the other drives an armoured jeep; Ronald Pieket Weeserik's Amiga conversion became legendary for couch co-op.

games.title: Wings
games.note: Cinemaware's World War I pilot drama blended 3D dogfighting, strafing runs, and a personal wartime diary across over 200 missions on the Amiga.

games.title: Moonstone: A Hard Days Knight
games.note: Rob Anderson's dark-fantasy Amiga cult classic combined a four-player board-game overworld with visceral real-time sword duels against beasts and rival knights.

games.title: SWIV
games.note: Spiritual successor to Silkworm that moved the helicopter-and-jeep co-op partnership to a seamless vertically scrolling battlefield with zero loading pauses.

games.title: Super Cars II
games.note: Split-screen top-down combat racer with missiles, mines, and cheeky between-race multiple-choice interviews with sponsors and police.

games.title: Gobliiins
games.note: Muriel Tramis and Pierre Gilhodes' single-screen puzzle adventure where players coordinate three specialist goblins—warrior, magician, and technician—to solve slapstick contraptions.

games.title: Jaguar XJ220
games.note: Core Design's Amiga racer paired fast sprite-scaled road racing and Martin Iveson's CD-style soundtrack with a built-in track editor.

games.title: Benefactor
games.note: Swedish studio Digital Illusions (later DICE) followed its Pinball series with this inventive puzzle-platformer starring Ben E. Factor rescuing stranded Merry Men.

games.title: Slam Tilt
games.note: AGA Amiga pinball showcase built in Sweden for 21st Century Entertainment, pushing multi-ball physics and dot-matrix mini-games at the end of the commercial Amiga era.

links.took: Asymmetric two-player helicopter-and-jeep co-op where air and ground vehicles cover each other's blind spots
links.added: Vertical scrolling, continuous uninterrupted streaming stages, and overhead 360-degree jeep turret aiming
